name: Theramore Spies
summary: The truce between Horde and Alliance is an uneasy one, with skirmishes and covert deeds on both sides. Nazeer Bloodpike in Brackenwall Village wants the Alliance infiltrators east of the village hunted down and slain.

sections.title: Spies East of the Village
sections.body: Alliance infiltrators have settled in east of Brackenwall Village, watching it and sending word of Horde movements to Theramore. Nazeer Bloodpike, the local spymaster, will not stand for it. You are sent to find the infiltrators and kill them, so that their superiors know such spies are unwelcome.

faq.q: Who orders the death of the Theramore infiltrators?
faq.answer: Nazeer Bloodpike, the local spymaster in Brackenwall Village.
East of Brackenwall Village, on the islands.

faq.q: Why are the spies watching Brackenwall Village?
aliases: why are humans spying on brackenwall
faq.answer: They watch the village and pass word of Horde movements back to Theramore.

faq.q: What comes after dealing with the spies?
aliases: what quest comes after theramore spies
faq.answer: The next step in the story is The Theramore Docks.
